mapper.select: SELECT rating AS rating, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ck_shop_product_review WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND del_flag = 0 AND status = 'Y' GROUP BY rating

SELECT oi.id AS orderItemId, oi.product_id AS productId, oi.product_name AS productName, oi.sku_name AS skuName, oi.product_image AS productImage, oi.quantity AS quantity, CASE WHEN rv.id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS reviewed FROM ck_shop_order_item oi INNER JOIN ck_shop_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id LEFT JOIN ck_shop_product_review rv ON rv.order_item_id = oi.id AND rv.del_flag = 0 WHERE o.order_no = #{orderNo} AND o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.del_flag = 0 AND oi.del_flag = 0 AND o.pay_status IN ('PAID', 'PARTIAL_REFUND') AND o.order_status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'CLOSED') ORDER BY oi.create_time ASC, oi.id ASC

SELECT oi.id AS orderItemId, oi.product_id AS productId, oi.product_name AS productName, oi.sku_name AS skuName, oi.product_image AS productImage, oi.quantity AS quantity, oi.sku_id AS skuId, o.id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.store_id AS storeId, o.store_org_code AS storeOrgCode, o.user_id AS userId, o.pay_status AS payStatus, o.order_status AS orderStatus FROM ck_shop_order_item oi INNER JOIN ck_shop_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE oi.id = #{orderItemId} AND o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.del_flag = 0 AND oi.del_flag = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM ck_shop_product_review WHERE order_item_id = #{orderItemId} AND del_flag = 0 LIMIT 1
